chunks: There are some among them who blame you (of partiality) in distributing the offerings made in the name of God. In case they receive some of these they are pleased, if not, they are incensed.
ai.seo_question: How do hypocrites behave regarding the distribution of charity and why do they criticize it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological mechanism of the hypocrites (munafiqun), whose praise or criticism of the Prophet’s charity distribution was driven by worldly gain rather than spiritual sincerity. It underscores the principle that true contentment in divine distribution requires detachment from material expectations, a key theme in understanding the Prophet's leadership during the Medinan period.
